label: Series termination at the source
subgoals: Subtract the driver resistance from Z0
Place the resulting resistor in series at the driver
Confirm the receiver is at the far end of a point-to-point net

label: Parallel termination at the load
subgoals: Choose a terminator equal to Z0 at the receiver
Compute its DC power as the line voltage squared over Z0
Check the driver swing against the divider into Z0

label: Thevenin termination
subgoals: Set the parallel combination of the two resistors equal to Z0
Set the open-circuit divider voltage to the target
Solve for the pull-up and pull-down resistances
